Flower City Feeling Good Wednesday Ride

Rochester, NY · Social

Flower City Feeling Good Wednesday Ride is a social group ride in Rochester, NY. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from A different Rochester recreation center or park each week (Oct 7: Schiller Park, 350 Andrews St). About 7 miles, casual but steady, about 9 mph.

For visitors

Helmets required, bikes not provided. Get there by 5:30 pm and R Community Bikes will check that your bike is rideable. You need to be able to hold a steady pace. Check the calendar for each week's start.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 9 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Flower City Feeling Good Wednesday Ride group ride

A free guided ride for the City of Rochester Recreation Department, led by Reconnect Rochester. Each week is about 7 miles on a different route and shows how the city's bike boulevards link neighborhoods. The pace is easy but steady, and the ride is over in about an hour.
